boundary: Structural facts only: operation names, HTTP methods, paths, and field shapes for the three Apollo-related operations Foundry's Control Panel declares. No Palantir prose is copied -- the source projection carries zero docs: entries, so there is none to copy. No tenant identity, hostname, credential or environment name is recorded. This establishes the Foundry-to-Apollo administrative seam and nothing about Apollo's own Hub API.

source.derivation: bytecode-exact projection of the published Maven artifact, not hand-authored
source.note: The Maven coordinate is product identity rather than tenant identity, which is why it is named. The artifact is the authority; the file path holding the projection has already moved once upstream and is deliberately not recorded here.

ApolloBootstrapConfiguration.note: appears beside foundry: optional<FoundryBootstrapConfiguration> in the enrollment bootstrap type; carries no configuration

vocabularyCollisions.inThisSeam: PalSec accreditation markings applied to a Foundry resource: security accreditation, personhood, offering type
vocabularyCollisions.inApollo: operator-defined labels on Environments, Entities, Product Releases and Teams, with a governed definition catalogue
vocabularyCollisions.consequence: The two are unrelated. A join on the spelling would produce a plausible wrong answer, which is the defect class this repository has already been burned by. Conduit's label model must never be fed from this seam.

vocabularyCollisions.inThisSeam: a Foundry-side rid minted by Control Panel and returned to the caller
vocabularyCollisions.inApollo: ApolloSpaceId, typed as an opaque string in the pinned interop IR and linked to Foundry by Maven group
vocabularyCollisions.consequence: Nothing here establishes that the two are the same identifier, nor the format of either. Treating spaceRid as an ApolloSpaceId would be an invented correspondence.

whatThisDoesNotEstablish: Any Apollo Hub contract. No Apollo Hub Conjure service exists in the corpus this was taken from.
Any ri.apollo.* RID grammar. The string ri.apollo does not occur anywhere in the corpus.
That a Space id ever attaches to a resource Conduit holds, which is the condition ADR 0005 records for reopening the Space refusal. That condition remains unmet.
Cardinality or idempotency of Space creation. The path is parameterized by enrollment and organization; the contract states neither.
Anything about notification delivery. The only adjacent trace is a monitoring route returning an untyped array, already recorded in ROLE-INTERFACE-INVENTORY.md.
